admission.justification: Manufacturing a missing-row duty from a metadata-only change would falsely fail valid curation; ignoring explicit expected rows would falsely pass it.

applicability: Eval grading of actual invariant/family/onboarding history duties from captured trees and explicit case authority.
conditions: Product meaning comparison distinguishes revision, status, existence, entry-set and row changes.
Admission-only metadata does not invent a generic required row.
Hash-bound expected outcomes and case-specific rubric authority can explicitly require a row.
exclusions: Inferring a row duty from actor success text.
Deleting retained withdrawn-duty evidence or claiming an instrument correction proves actor success.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: History grading derives duties from meaning, stated case outcomes and rubric authority rather than manufacturing a row from an admission-only field change.
